text: Local control panels shall exist only for packages delivered with own PLC (e.g. SWRO, condensate polishing, chlorination, gas station, LDO unloading, compressors, water treatment); each package PLC shall be operated from the DCS through a serial or Ethernet link (Modbus TCP or OPC UA) and shall run its sequences autonomously; the local panel shall be the exception, used for maintenance and commissioning.
